Subject: Archon — inference architecture session: availability and prep

Hi Emma,

Thanks again for the call this morning — really appreciated the level of detail on your inference workload and the latency/cost goals. We recommend doing a focused 60-minute architecture review next, where our SE will walk through a proposed serving topology, network requirements (VPC / peering / egress), and performance expectations across model variants.

Suggested agenda (60 minutes):
- 5 min quick intros and goals
- 20 min current architecture + constraints (you)
- 25 min Redwood proposed serving topology + quantization/kv cache approach
- 5 min next steps and action items

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue 15 Jun: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed 16 Jun: 09:00–10:00

If you want us to include a short pre-checklist for firewall/VPC rules and test endpoints, we can attach that with the invite. Ive attached a draft agenda for review.

Would one of those time windows work? If so, please confirm attendees and any sensitive topics (e.g., air-gapped datasets, HSM/KMS) so we can tailor the session.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0126
